queries.result: Found the official Graz Geoportal pages and the official geodaten.graz.at ArcGIS REST folder/service for cadastral parcels.

queries.query: Graz offizielles Grundstückskataster GIS Kataster Grundstücke ArcGIS REST
queries.result: Found the official Stadt Graz Geoportal and the GBG/KATASTER_und_Städtische_Grundstücke service exposing the municipal cadastral parcel layer.

officialSources.evidence: Official city page identifies the Geoportal, online maps, geodata and the Stadtvermessungsamt as the municipal geoinformation custodian.
First-party REST service is titled KATASTER und Städtische Grundstücke and exposes polygon layers Haus Graz Grundstücke LINIEN and Haus Graz Grundstücke.
First-party map service identifies the broader Kataster Graz und GU map and a Grundstücke sublayer in EPSG:31256.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Anonymous TLS GET returned service metadata, currentVersion 11.3, polygon layer IDs 1 and 2, Query capability, and service CRS EPSG:31256.
Anonymous TLS GET returned layer schema: polygon geometry, OBJECTID object-id field, KG and GRSTNR cadastral fields, EPSG:31256 source/extent, and GeoJSON query support.

Point intersects query used the exact immutable WUP point in EPSG:4326, requested only OBJECTID, KG_GNR, KG and GRSTNR plus geometry, and returned one polygon: OBJECTID 17411, KG 63106, GRSTNR 59/12. Geometry was converted by the service to GeoJSON EPSG:4326 for the retained sample.

A bounded nearby-envelope query was attempted with a three-record limit but did not complete within the request window. This does not affect the successful exact-point response and is not evidence of absence.

sourceIdentity.crs: EPSG:31256 (MGI / Austria GK West), service source and extent; query output requested EPSG:4326

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Graz cadastral and city-property parcel service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official service metadata and one exact-point parcel response were verified; citywide completeness was not independently enumerated.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: The exact WUP point intersects the returned polygon; no coordinate shift was used.

remainingUncertainty: The returned service is a municipal/GBG parcel layer rather than proof of the Austrian nationwide cadastral system; layer coverage, update cadence and long-term stability require independent serial qualification. The retained composite key uses native cadastral fields KG and GRSTNR; OBJECTID is also recorded in evidence but not retained in the sample properties.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify a bounded adapter, verify coverage and identity stability, and keep runtime readiness held until that review.
